name: XD VPS · Ubuntu SSH + 9router
description: Ubuntu 24.04 SSH VPS di Railway. Root langsung, password default Kurr123@. Setup AI di UI web 9router. Dev: KurrXd.
readme:
# Railway Ubuntu Docker

Ubuntu SSH + 9router di Railway. Klik Deploy, variabel boleh kosong.

Password default: `Kurr123@`

- SSH TCP port 22
- 9router HTTP port 20128
- Backup opsional: `GITHUB_TOKEN` + `GITHUB_REPO` (kosong = auto-buat repo)

Repo: https://github.com/asepbalon121221/RailwayUBUNTUDOCKER

© XD VPS · KurrXd

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Password root + login dashboard 9router. Kosong = Kurr123@.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Token GitHub (scope repo). Wajib kalau mau backup. PAT: ghp_...

GITHUB_REPO.description: Repo backup: owner/name atau URL. Kosong = auto-buat xd-vps-src-<id>. Launch: restore sekali, lalu auto-backup.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key untuk root. Opsional. Password tetap aktif.

SSH_USERNAME.description: User sudo tambahan. Isi bareng SSH_PASSWORD.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password user sudo tambahan. Isi bareng SSH_USERNAME.

SYNC_INTERVAL.description: Jeda sync /root/src (detik). Hanya dipakai kalau GITHUB_TOKEN diisi.
